title: Allard regularity theorem (Simon 5.5.2)
statement: For n >= 1, l, p > n there are delta_0, gamma in (0,1) and C, depending only on n,l,p, such that for every open U, V with generalized mean curvature H, 0 < delta <= delta_0 and rho with AllardHypotheses H p delta rho, AllardConclusion V p delta rho gamma C holds: there are a linear isometry q of R^(n+l) and u: R^n -> R^l, C^1 on the closed ball B^n_{gamma rho}(0), with u(0) = 0, Du(0) = 0 (derivative within the ball), spt V cap B_{gamma rho}(0) = q(graph u over B^n_{gamma rho}(0)) cap B_{gamma rho}(0), and rho^-1 sup|u| + sup|Du| + rho^(1-n/p) sup_{x != y} |x - y|^-(1-n/p) |Du(x) - Du(y)| <= C delta^(1/(2n+2)) (suprema over the closed ball, Hilbert-Schmidt norms, in [0,inf]).
